candidates.exact_user_question: Which supported skilled-work routes match this explicit snapshot, and what is missing or unmet?
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations fully assessable from official sources, or an owner-approved bounded subset of at least 12 destinations with explicit unsupported states.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: No supported route matched only when the frozen supported route inventory is complete for the snapshot date.
candidates.public_limitations: Positive or conditional matches only across the frozen named-route inventory; never predicts invitation, sponsorship or grant.

candidates.public_name: Dependants on supported work and study routes
candidates.exact_user_question: Can the declared household roles accompany or reunify under a supported route, and what conditions and work rights apply?
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations fully assessable for one frozen primary-route family, with all other route families explicit as unsupported.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: No supported family route matched is limited to the declared primary route/status and household roles.
candidates.public_limitations: Limited to partner/child conditions attached to the frozen supported primary routes; not a general family-reunification checker.

candidates.public_name: Post-study stay and work route check
candidates.exact_user_question: Does this institution, qualification and study scenario match a supported post-study work or stay route?
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 15/91 stable destinations fully assessable from official routes and institution/qualification registers.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: No supported route matched only for completed/current study facts and a complete destination route inventory; planned future graduation remains provisional.
candidates.public_limitations: Checks current/completed study facts against frozen routes; future graduation remains provisional and institution identity must be verified.

candidates.exact_user_question: Which supported permanent or settled residence pathways match now or conditionally, and which requirements remain?
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations fully assessable for a frozen set of employment/study-to-residence route families.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Future pathway is conditional, not promised; no-match applies only to supported routes and supplied history.
candidates.public_limitations: Current sources do not form a complete route inventory or normalize residence-history counting.

candidates.exact_user_question: For this bounded profession, qualification origin and jurisdiction, what supported recognition and licensing steps apply?
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least two precisely defined profession families across at least 5/8 anchors, with one explicit regulator/jurisdiction record per supported combination.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Report unmet or unsupported requirements; never claim the applicant cannot practise outside the frozen protected scope and regulator route.
candidates.public_limitations: Database coverage does not replace profession-, regulator- and jurisdiction-specific recognition rules.

candidates.exact_user_question: Under this employment and household scenario, what employee income tax and mandatory deductions are estimated?
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations with reproducible official parameters for one frozen employee household model and tax year.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Return an estimate/range with assumptions and excluded filing circumstances; never tax advice or a guaranteed payslip.
candidates.public_limitations: OECD benchmark households cannot yield an arbitrary applicant payslip; national formulas remain required.

candidates.exact_user_question: For this target locality, household and housing assumption, what supported housing-cost range and income/budget share apply?
required_inputs: gross/net income or budget and currency
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20 canonical cities across at least 12 stable destinations with like-for-like official rental evidence.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Report a sourced range and ratio, not availability, neighbourhood fit or a promise that housing can be secured.
candidates.public_limitations: Reference-city standardized-dwelling rents are not representative national rents; the frozen 6-of-8-anchor floor is not met.

candidates.exact_user_question: Under this immigration/status and household scenario, what required system-level healthcare costs can be estimated and what is excluded?
required_inputs: household size/child ages where premiums vary
candidates.predeclared_coverage_floor: At least 6/8 anchors and 20/91 stable destinations with reproducible official eligibility and mandatory-cost parameters for one frozen status/household model.
candidates.safe_negative_boundary: Estimate required system costs only; do not collect health conditions or estimate personal treatment needs/out-of-pocket events.
candidates.public_limitations: MISSOC describes systems but does not provide comparable mandatory-cost formulas for the supported applicant model.
